TRIGGER TOUCH FILE — OTA-1390
=============================

Editing this file (add a line, save, commit) is how you fire the workflows whose
push trigger is path-filtered. It exists so nobody has to edit a workflow's own
comment block to make it run — which is what was actually being done for months;
build-apk.yml's header is a stack of "trigger-touch" notes that are edits to a
comment and nothing else.

WHY IT IS NEEDED
----------------
build-apk.yml and build-ios.yml ignore app/**, assets/**, scripts/**,
__tests__/** and **.md. That is right — a JS-only change ships over the air and
must not spend 30-60 minutes of runner time. But it also means an OTA-stamp
commit (which only touches app/buildInfo.ts and VERSION.md) fires NOTHING, so a
commit-title marker like [build-aab] alone does nothing at all: the workflow
never starts, so it never reads the marker.

.github/** is NOT path-ignored. Touching this file starts those workflows; the
commit-title marker then decides what they actually build.

HOW TO USE IT
-------------
  1. Add a dated line at the bottom saying what you are firing and why.
  2. Put the marker in the FIRST LINE of the commit title.
  3. Commit both together.

MARKERS (see docs/WORKFLOWS.md for the full table)
--------------------------------------------------
  [build-aab]        production AAB for the Play Console      (needs this touch)
  [build-ios]        TestFlight-ready IPA via EAS             (needs this touch)
  [submit-ios]       ...and auto-submit it to TestFlight      (with [build-ios])
  [build-ios-native] IPA on a GitHub macOS runner             (no touch needed)
  [build-exe]        portable Windows .exe                    (no touch needed)
  [build-linux]      Linux / Steam Deck AppImage              (no touch needed)
  [build-dmg]        unsigned macOS .dmg                      (no touch needed)
  [build-desktop]    all three desktop targets at once        (no touch needed)
  [ota-hal]          publish the OTA to the LIVE HAL channels (no touch needed)
  [ota-ios-only]     / [ota-android-only] — narrow an OTA to one platform

⚠ A marker is not a formality. [build-aab] produces a Play-Store-bound bundle and
[ota-hal] reaches people who are actually playing. Do not put one in a commit
unless that build is genuinely intended.
